judgments.reason: The support_span ('total occlusion of the right coronary artery (RCA) and subtotal occlusion of the left main coronary artery (LMCA)') is quoted literally in the vignette, but it describes the angiographic finding of occlusion without specifying atherosclerosis as the etiology. The vignette does not explicitly state that the occlusions are atherosclerotic in nature; other causes (e.g., thromboembolism, vasospasm, dissection) are not ruled out by the cited span alone. Thus the span does not clinically support the 'atherosclerotic' modifier specifically.
